description: This file defines the TransactionalStateOptions class, which encapsulates configuration options related to transactional state management in Orleans. It contains properties for various timeout durations, retry configurations, and lock management parameters, along with their default values.

classes.name: TransactionalStateOptions
classes.description: Class providing configurable options for transactional state, such as timeouts, retry limits, and lock group sizes.

methods.name: DefaultLockTimeout
methods.description: Default timeout for acquiring a lock in a transactional state.

methods.name: DefaultPrepareTimeout
methods.description: Default timeout for transaction prepare phase.

methods.name: DefaultLockAcquireTimeout
methods.description: Default maximum wait time for acquiring a lock.

methods.name: DefaultRemoteTransactionPingFrequency
methods.description: Default frequency for remote transaction pings.

methods.name: DefaultConfirmationRetryDelay
methods.description: Default delay between transaction confirmation retries.

methods.name: DefaultConfirmationRetryLimit
methods.description: Default maximum number of confirmation retries.
